cross_border.shipments.page.title: Shipments
cross_border.shipments.page.description: Consignments from the domestic supplier to the overseas warehouse; export documents — the packing list (PL), the customs declaration, the bill of lading — are registered in the document section of the detail page.
cross_border.shipments.list.searchPlaceh: Search by shipment number, carrier or container no.
cross_border.shipments.departConfirmBody: The shipment gets its number and every allocated purchase order that is still placed becomes shipped.
cross_border.shipments.cancelConfirmBody: Cancelled shipments release their allocated quantities; received stock is not reversed.
cross_border.shipments.cancelReasonRequi: Give a reason for the cancellation
cross_border.shipments.receive.title: Receive shipment
cross_border.shipments.form.field.carrie: Suggestions come from the carrier dictionary the dictionary library maintains; a carrier it does not list yet can still be typed.
cross_border.shipments.form.field.depart: Suggestions come from the port dictionary the dictionary library maintains; a port it does not list yet can still be typed.
cross_border.shipments.contracts.title: Linked contracts
cross_border.shipments.contracts.help: One container may carry goods from several contracts; this is where the shipment's purchase/sales contracts are kept.
cross_border.shipments.contracts.draftOn: Only a draft shipment can change its contract links.
cross_border.shipments.contracts.select: Search and pick a purchase/sales contract
cross_border.shipments.contracts.empty: This shipment is not linked to any contract yet.
cross_border.shipments.contracts.saveFai: Failed to save the contract links.
cross_border.shipments.contracts.dialogD: Pick the purchase/sales contracts this shipment belongs to; one container may carry goods from several contracts.
cross_border.shipments.allocations.refer: Pick a contract and match its line items against the purchase/sales order lines this shipment already allocates from; a match becomes an allocation in one click, and a line without one says why.

cross_border.shipments.milestones.title: Milestones
cross_border.shipments.documents.title: Export documents
cross_border.shipments.documents.commerc: Commercial invoices are now structured documents.
cross_border.packingLists.page.title: Packing lists (PL)
cross_border.packingLists.page.descripti: One of a shipment's export documents: number, issue date and file. Pick the shipment when registering — the file is filed under it, and one shipment may carry several.
cross_border.packingLists.list.emptyHint: Register one in a shipment's document section, or pick a shipment here.
cross_border.packingLists.list.loadFaile: Could not load the packing lists
cross_border.packingLists.form.editDescr: Shipment: {shipment}. A packing list stays on the shipment it was filed under; it cannot be moved to another one.
cross_border.packingLists.form.help.ship: The file is filed under the shipment you pick; a draft has no number yet, so it shows its status and container number.
cross_border.packingLists.form.attachmen: Pick a shipment first, then upload the file.
cross_border.packingLists.removeConfirmB: Removing it takes the packing list out of the ledger and the shipment's document section; the uploaded file stays in the attachment library.
cross_border.packingLists.form.loadFaile: Failed to load the packing list
cross_border.packingLists.form.lines.hel: One row per packed item: quantity, cartons, gross weight, net weight and volume may be left blank and edited at any time — or pulled in bulk from a contract's line items first.
cross_border.packingLists.form.lines.emp: No lines yet. Add one, or reference the contract's line items.
cross_border.packingLists.form.lines.sel: Search and pick a product (leave blank to type a name)
cross_border.packingLists.form.reference: Pick a contract and copy its line items into editable packing lines; the two stay independent afterwards.
